scan.summary: This is the OLCC-issued Producer license authorizing Evergreen Botanicals, LLC to cultivate marijuana (Tier II, Indoor) at the Bailey Hill premises. It is the agency's own document, so there is nothing in it to fix; what matters to the company is meeting the five listed conditions and renewing before the license expires.
scan.freshness_note: The document reflects the current license term issued March 3, 2026, running to March 2, 2027 — it is current and does not need replacement yet, but renewal must begin well before the March 2027 expiration.

conditions.title: Operate only at the named, non-transferable premises
conditions.evidence_expected: Records showing no relocation or transfer of the license without a new application; premises diagram on file matching 2210 Bailey Hill Road.

conditions.title: Submit renewal application and fee at least 20 days before expiration
conditions.evidence_expected: Copy of submitted renewal application and proof of fee payment dated on or before February 10, 2027 (20 days before March 2, 2027); confirmation of submission in OLCC's system.

conditions.title: Track all marijuana items in CTS and ensure workers hold current permits
conditions.evidence_expected: CTS account activity/reports; current marijuana worker permits for each employee handling marijuana items.

conditions.evidence_expected: Surveillance system logs, camera placement diagram, and recording retention records showing at least 90 days of footage kept.

conditions.title: Report any change in ownership, premises, or financial-interest holders before it takes effect
conditions.evidence_expected: Correspondence or filings with OLCC documenting any ownership/premises change requests submitted in advance.

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence in reading the license fields and conditions directly from the document. I verified via search that the 90-day surveillance retention period and the 20-day pre-expiration renewal deadline in the document match current OLCC rules (OAR 845-025-1450 and OAR 845-025-1070), so these terms appear current and correctly stated. As this is the agency's own permit, there are no gaps to identify against a standard — only conditions to track.
scan.extracted_text:
OREGON LIQUOR AND CANNABIS COMMISSION
9079 SE McLoughlin Blvd, Portland, Oregon 97222
RECREATIONAL MARIJUANA PRODUCER LICENSE
License number: 020-1004763A8B2
Licensee: Evergreen Botanicals, LLC
Trade name: Evergreen Botanicals
Licensed premises: 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405
License type: Producer — Tier II, Indoor
Canopy limit: 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy
Original issue date: March 3, 2022
Current term: March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027
Expiration date: March 2, 2027
This license is issued under ORS 475C and the rules of the Commission in OAR chapter 845, division 25, and
authorizes the licensee to produce marijuana at the licensed premises named above, subject to those rules and to the
conditions below.
Conditions of this license:
1. The license is valid only for the premises named above and is not transferable to any other location or person.
2. The license must be renewed annually. A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the
Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date. A licensee that has submitted a complete renewal
application before that date may continue to operate until the Commission acts on it.
3. All marijuana items at the premises must be tracked in the Cannabis Tracking System, and every employee who
handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission.
4. Video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 must be maintained at the premises and recordings kept for at
least 90 days.
5. Any change in ownership, in the premises, or in the persons with a financial interest in the licensee must be
reported to the Commission before it takes effect.
This license must be displayed at the licensed premises where it can be seen by the public.
Issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission
Date of issue for the current term: March 3, 2026
Authorized signature: ____________________ Licensing Director
